_note: Demo examples for the Samosir test region, written by Claude. llm_output is what a model would be expected to return for the message; it was written by hand, not produced by a model (D14). Messages not listed here get no model output, so the server uses rules and follow-up questions only. Batak Toba text was written by Claude from general knowledge and has not been checked by a native speaker.
